summary: This is a meta-audit task that independently re-verifies 10 previously-dispatched tasks and recovers real gaps found (missing files never committed to master, an unrun task-gateway close, a missing MASTER_INDEX registry entry) rather than a feature change; the diff is entirely additive (new docs/schema/plan/evidence YAML and JSON files, a recovered test file, a recovered patch-record diff, one small idempotent Python script that appends a registry entry to MASTER_INDEX.yaml via atomic tmp-file+os.replace with no shell/eval/subprocess calls) with no modifications to existing application logic. Spot-verification confirms the claims are real and not just self-reported: tests/worker_noop_pending_review_test.sh was executed against the actual live /opt/veridian/scripts/worker-entrypoint.sh and all 3 scenarios (genuine no-op, self-committed, dirty tree) pass exactly as claimed, and the live MASTER_INDEX.yaml was independently confirmed to contain both the auditor_engine and testing_engine_irvf registry entries the diff claims to have added/recovered. No file in the diff touches .github/workflows/**, migrations, schema.sql/prisma, auth/, or any permission/payment/billing/rls/security path segment, and there is no heavy-deletion pattern, so the deterministic tier1 classification is consistent with the diff's actual content. No correctness, architecture, or security issues found.
